items.event_time_ist: Expected later today, Tue Oct 13 (5 AM PDT TWOEP issued 5:30 PM IST)
items.summary: NHC Tropical Weather Outlook 5 AM PDT Tue Oct 13: Invest EP93 south of southern Mexico has showers and thunderstorms becoming better organized with a better-defined circulation; formation chance remains high near 100% (48h and 7d). If trends continue, NHC says advisories are likely to be initiated later today on a tropical depression or tropical storm, moving generally WNW around 10 mph. The system is NOT yet classified - still no tropical depression and no Tropical Storm Trudy.
items.title: NHC: EP93 likely to get tropical-cyclone advisories 'later today' - still unnamed (next name Trudy)

items.event_time_ist: Tue Oct 13 (8 AM EDT TWOAT issued 5:30 PM IST)
items.summary: NHC Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook 8 AM EDT Tue Oct 13: the low-pressure trough a few hundred miles west-northwest of the Cabo Verde Islands is no longer expected to develop as it moves slowly north into strong upper-level winds; formation chance now low, near 0 percent for both 48 hours and 7 days. No tropical cyclones are active in the Atlantic. The only Atlantic formation watch item in this watch drops out.
items.title: Atlantic Cabo Verde disturbance fizzles out - formation chance now near 0%
